pathAssistantSteps.info: A broker brought a prospect. Qualify the requirement and set the ball in court to Landlord for the first response.
Counter-offers are in flight. Log every round in the negotiation history so nothing is lost.
First formal offer is in. Record the LOI date and forward to the landlord for review.
Key terms are locked. Capture the agreed LOI terms — they stay fixed from here.
Legal is drafting the lease. A Lease record is created for the legal team — track its Draft → Prepare/Review → Completed progress in the Lease Status panel.
Legal has finished the lease document and it is ready for signature. Confirm the executed copy is in hand before closing.
Deal done — the space is leased. Set Status to Closed Won to close the record out in history.
